content:
Ready for a full Class 1 Maths Olympiad rehearsal? A real IMO paper mixes every chapter — numbers, addition, subtraction, shapes, measurement, data handling and reasoning — in one 30-question set. This free test gives you a 10-question taste, and the practice-papers e-book gives you 25 complete papers.

What a Class 1 IMO practice paper looks like

  • 30 questions in one paper, balanced across all 8 chapters
  • A mix of number work, shapes, measurement, data and reasoning
  • An answer key and step-by-step solution for every question
  • Graded intermediate to hard, just like the real Olympiad

How to use practice papers well

  • Sit one paper in a quiet 30–40 minute slot, no help
  • Mark it with the answer key, then read the solution for every wrong one
  • Note which chapter the mistakes cluster in and revise that chapter
  • Repeat weekly — steady practice beats last-minute cramming

Take the free mixed test

The 10 questions below are pulled from across the syllabus. The full 25 Practice Papers e-book has 750 questions — 25 papers of 30 — each fully solved.

Learn the syllabus first with the free IMO Maths Olympiad course at vidaara.org.

quiz.title: IMO Class 1 Maths Mixed Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten questions from across the syllabus. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: In the number 57, what does the digit 7 stand for?
questions.explanation: In 57, the 7 is in the ones place, so its value is just 7.

questions.q: A digit is hidden: 5_ + 32 = 89. What is the hidden digit?
questions.explanation: The first number must be 57, because 57 + 32 = 89. So the hidden digit is 7.
Count back from 15: take away 8 and you land on 7. So 15 − 8 = 7.

questions.q: A pattern repeats like this: red, blue, red, blue, ... What is the 10th colour?
questions.explanation: The block of 2 repeats. The 10th colour matches the 2nd one in the block, so it is blue.

questions.q: Which day of the week is 3 days before Saturday?
questions.explanation: Count 3 days back from Saturday on the week: you land on Wednesday.

questions.q: The table shows stars earned: Wed 6, Thu 11, Fri 8. How many more stars earned on Thu than on Wed?
A pile is made from bottom to top: maths book, drawing book, story book, rhyme book, sticker book. Which one is 4th from the top?
questions.explanation: The top one is the sticker book. Counting down 4 places gives the drawing book.

questions.q: Bird is to fly as fish is to ___?
questions.explanation: A bird moves by flying, and a fish moves by swimming.
Forty-seven means 4 tens and 7 ones, so it is 47.

questions.q: Mohan pays for a kite with Rs 10, Rs 10 and Rs 2. How much does the kite cost?
questions.explanation: Add the money: Rs 10 + Rs 10 + Rs 2 = Rs 22.
